name: 3dcraft
description: Open-source parametric 3D CAD built with and for AI: every action a command, every result checked.
long_description:
3DCraft is an open-source parametric 3D CAD modeller built with and for AI: every action is a command, and every result is checked.

With this extension your AI assistant models real parts. It runs 3DCraft's commands, inspects the document and shows you pictures it renders. Variables with units and formulas drive the model; volumes, distances and design rules are checked from the exact geometry; what 3DCraft cannot do yet, it refuses, and says so. Models are saved as `.3dcraft` files in the work folder you choose, and exported as STEP, STL, 3MF, OBJ, DXF or SVG.

This extension works without a window. To watch the assistant build in a window, point at a face and play the history, install 3DCraft from https://3dcraft.dev and connect it as the guide describes.

3DCraft is at version @SERIES@. It does not replace professional CAD today.
